>
[Plant Empathy](/Feats.aspx?ID=4711) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Druid" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=583" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 127

_[**PFS Note**](/pathfinder-society) The Plant Empathy druid feat can be used to speak to any plant or fungus. However, GMs should remember that this feat does not alter a plant's intelligence, and that everyday plants would therefore know very little about their surroundings._

</column>

---

You have a connection to flora that allows you to communicate with them on a rudimentary level. You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with plants and fungus.
